producer_report.summary: The seen-running rule in `judge` now counts a check Athena skipped by the docs-only path rule as seen, but only when the change touches only docs. `VerdictInputs` has a new `changed_paths` field. A change is docs-only when the list is not empty and every path matches `docs/` or `*.md` through `checks::path_matches`. A skipped record then counts when it passed, has no exit code, was not reused, is not a revert run, and its note starts with the `skip_when_only` note. A passing check reused from CI already counted and is unchanged. Root cause: a skipped check has no exit code, so the rule never accepted it, and the many-agents note was rejected for a command Athena had skipped on purpose. `verification_stage` fills `changed_paths` from `closing.candidate.changes`, the list the skip decision used. Three new tests and a CHANGELOG entry cover the change. In the test run, all 131 `athena-core` verify-filter tests passed. fmt and clippy are clean, and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` passed (17 tests).

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs has a docs-only change (changed paths only under docs/ or *.md) with clippy skipped by the skip_when_only rule and test reused from GitHub CI. A criterion citing `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` is met, with commands_verified true and no D43 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify` to check.
criteria_check.evidence: The new test `a_docs_only_change_counts_a_docs_skipped_check_and_a_ci_reused_check_as_seen` passed in `cargo test -p athena-core verify`. It uses paths `docs/design/many-agents.md` and `README.md`. Clippy is built with the real `checks::skip_note` and `checks::skipped_run`, and test is `reused_from_ci(true)`. It asserts met, commands_verified, no D43 finding, and a Pass verdict.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test has a code change (a .rs path changed) with clippy recorded as skipped. A criterion citing `cargo clippy` is still unmet, with commands_verified false and the 'cited but not seen running' finding. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify` to check.
criteria_check.evidence: `a_code_change_does_not_count_a_skipped_check_as_seen` passed in `cargo test -p athena-core verify`. It runs a .rs path, a mixed docs and .rs list, docs plus Cargo.toml, and an empty list. `assert_unseen` checks commands_verified false, met false and the 'cited but not seen running: `cargo clippy --all-targets`' D43 Major finding.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing tests still pass, including a_skipped_check_that_was_not_reused_does_not_count_as_run, a_failed_check_reused_from_ci_does_not_count_as_run and the other-tree tests; a skip for a reason other than the docs-only path rule, or a failed check, still does not count. Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full `cargo test`. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core verify` (131 passed, including the named existing tests and the other-tree tests) and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (clean). The new test `on_a_docs_only_change_only_a_docs_path_skip_that_passed_on_the_same_tree_counts` shows that on a docs-only change a 'CI was not green' skip, a record with no note, a failed record and a skip on another tree all stay unseen.

criteria_check.criterion: The doc comments on `VerdictInputs`/`judge` in verify.rs state the new rule: a check skipped by the docs-only path rule on a docs-only change counts as seen, and name the docs-only definition used.
criteria_check.evidence: Doc comments updated on `VerdictInputs::commands_run`, the new `VerdictInputs::changed_paths`, `judge`, `docs_only`, `DOCS_ONLY_PATTERNS` and `skipped_for_docs_only`. They state that a skipped check counts on a docs-only change, and that docs-only means a non-empty list where every path matches `docs/` or `*.md` via `checks::path_matches`. An empty list is not docs-only.

criteria_check.criterion: The change does not widen what counts as seen for non-docs changes. Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and read the diff with `git diff` to confirm the only new counting path is gated on docs-only changed paths.
criteria_check.evidence: The only new counting path in `judge` is the `(docs_change && skipped_for_docs_only(c))` clause, where `docs_change = docs_only(inputs.changed_paths)`. The code-change test covers code, mixed and empty path lists. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core verify` (131 passed), not the whole `cargo test -p athena-core`; the full suite is left to Athena's checks. I did not run `git diff` and read the source directly.

open_issues: Should the amendment to D43/D115 also be recorded in docs/decisions.md? That file is not a deliverable, so I left it unchanged.

The verdict hard-codes `docs/` and `*.md` rather than reading the config's skip_when_only patterns. If the config's patterns were broader, extra skips would still not count. The skip note wording is pinned only by the test that builds its record with `checks::skip_note`.
I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`; that is left to Athena's checks.
mistakes: My first test build failed because I imported `CheckKind` from `crate::capability`, where it is private. I fixed it to `athena_data::config::CheckKind`.
learnings: `CheckKind` is a private import in athena_core::capability; tests reach it as athena_data::config::CheckKind.
`cargo test -p athena-core verify` also matches run::tests (131 tests, ~110 s).
